test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting on a bench. Q is at the right end. R is sitting to the immediate right of S. U is sitting to the immediate left of T, and T is sitting to the immediate left of Q. P is sitting to the immediate left of S. Who is sitting at the left end?
solution: Total six friends:- P, Q, R, S, T and U 1) Q is at the right end. 2) U is sitting to the immediate left of T, and T is sitting to the immediate left of Q.
